During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Justa]] in the [[Killaniri system/Legends|Killaniri system]], located ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Justa starport]]. It had a [[Soldier/Legends|troop]] complement of six hundred.
